note: The live calendar does not move focus with the arrow or Page keys (Chromium and WebKit, any date), so the scenario has no grid key steps. The live page is prerendered with its build day as today. The record and the drift check pin the page clock to a fixed day (dates.clock.day, the test day 2026-10-28), so React renders the calendar again on the client with that day (hydration error 418, no visible effect after the load) and every record shows the same dates on any build day. The record stores the dates the live page shows, and the check copies them to data-today and data-value.
